posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
its one of my favorite cards too

 

on the left is The Dreamer with her Ape, that might be a Void Shard in its forehead (meaning she might be partially like Idealist?). 

There is I assume The Naturalist (because Green, which all of cards indicate is his color, and has a FV symbol on his chest.) as a Raven, which means he could have Matriarchs Power.

Nightmist has green hair instead of white. And green energy in her hands. And that looks like a reed pipe rigaht there in the center. That might indicate she is the Virtuoso of the Void - given that she has gone to the void, and we know Adept is tightly connected to the Void, that makes some sort of sense.

It might also not be Nightmist, but Harpy who got Nightmists Curse instead. Not sure.

Tachyon as a an Omnitron Robot.

 

 

On the Right is Tempest with red lightning, perhaps Empyreon? (red energy bolts). Could also be in connection with Friction? Hard to tell on that one.

Setback combined with Mr Fixer, might have some of Zhu Long's power given the glyph on his chest. 

The girl is Kismet. If you look real close above her shoulder you can see the Talisman.

And of course a heroic Plague Rat
